Name: Predict Reaction To Gift
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[center][b][size=4][/size][/b][/center][left][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Predict the NPC's reaction to the gift and display it with an emote  bubble.
[*]You can anticipate the NPC's thoughts on the gift, avoiding giving a terrible present that would upset them.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]You can customize this[b] [/b]mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][b].[/b]
[*]If you think unconditional prediction of gift reactions is a form of cheating, enable [b][color=#6aa84f]"RequireGiftLog"[/color][/b] in GMCM to only show reactions for gifts that have already been given.
[*]If you are using other mods to modify the NPC weekly gift limit, please make the corresponding adjustments in [b][color=#6aa84f]"GiftWeekLimit"[/color][/b] in GMCM .
[/list][b]
